NotificationBodyItem.description: A content item. For P (text), alt is not applicable and val is text content. For I (image), alt is an image description and val is an image URL. For A (URL), alt is a link description and val is a link URL.

NotificationId.description: Unique identifier of the notification. The specification does not state a wire type.

NotificationListItem.description: Fields documented for an item in the notification list. The specification does not state field requiredness or a complete response envelope.

exp_ts.description: Expiry time of the notification, in milliseconds since 1 January 1970.

schedule_ts.description: Effective time of the notification, in milliseconds since 1 January 1970.

SourceId.description: The first two or three letters identify the supplying organisation. These are documented prefixes, not complete closed identifier values; the retained detail value TD0001 is valid. Suffix syntax is undocumented.

x-prefix-descriptions.HKC: Hong Kong Computer Emergency Response Team Coordination Center
x-prefix-descriptions.SFA: Working Family and Student Financial Assistance Agency

info.description: HTTP API for listing and retrieving alert notifications issued by bureaux and departments via the “iAM Smart” News & Alerts feature. The version is undocumented; the placeholder is not a publisher API version. Authentication requirements are not specified. The list service covers notifications from the past seven days; requesting messages older than seven days results in an empty message list.
info.title: "iAM Smart" News & Alerts

get.description: Lists alert notifications issued via “iAM Smart” News & Alerts. Only messages from the past seven days are available; requests for messages older than seven days result in an empty message list. The documented list response describes notification fields but does not specify a response envelope.

parameters.description: Preferred language. If omitted, the list is returned in English.
parameters.name: lang

parameters.description: Maximum number of notifications included in the list. If omitted, a maximum of 10 notifications are included. A larger number may be specified to obtain a full list of available notifications from the past seven days.
parameters.name: max

parameters.description: Page number of the message list. If omitted, only messages on page 1 are displayed. Increase this parameter to navigate to additional pages when messages remain.
parameters.name: page

schema.description: Observed application/x-javascript JSONP. Decode only the exact NotiList callback argument as JSON; do not execute JavaScript. This response is not direct JSON.

oneOf.description: A response object containing notification fields; the response envelope is not specified.

200.description: Notification list. The specification documents the fields of each item but does not establish the response envelope. Retained wire response is NotiList(JSON), not direct JSON.

get.description: Retrieves the detailed alert notification identified by its unique identifier, which can be found in the notification list. The publisher documents the response fields and content-item representation, but does not specify a complete response envelope.

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the notification; it can be found in the list of “iAM Smart” News & Alerts.
parameters.name: notification-id

schema.description: Observed application/x-javascript JSONP. Decode only the exact NotiDetail callback argument as JSON; do not execute JavaScript. This response is not direct JSON.

body.description: There could be any number of items in text (P), image (I), or URL (A) form.

exp_ts.description: Expiry time of the notification, in microseconds since 1 January 1970.

msg_en.description: Message of the notification in English.

msg_sc.description: Message of the notification in Simplified Chinese.

msg_tc.description: Message of the notification in Traditional Chinese.

schedule_ts.description: Effective time of the notification, in microseconds since 1 January 1970.

subject_en.description: Subject of the notification in English.

subject_sc.description: Subject of the notification in Simplified Chinese.

subject_tc.description: Subject of the notification in Traditional Chinese.

type.description: The documented content-format example gives the value R.

200.description: Detailed notification. The response envelope is not fully specified. Retained wire response is NotiDetail(JSON), not direct JSON.
